verses.text: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens; Praise Him in the heights!
verses.textZh: 你們要讚美耶和華！從天上讚美耶和華，在高處讚美他！

verses.text: Praise Him, all His angels; Praise Him, all His hosts!
verses.textZh: 他的眾使者都要讚美他！他的諸軍都要讚美他！

verses.text: Praise Him, sun and moon; Praise Him, all stars of light!
verses.textZh: 日頭月亮，你們要讚美他！放光的星宿，你們都要讚美他！

verses.text: Praise Him, highest heavens, And the waters that are above the heavens!
verses.textZh: 天上的天和天上的水，你們都要讚美他！

verses.text: Let them praise the name of the LORD, For He commanded and they were created.
verses.textZh: 願這些都讚美耶和華的名！因他一吩咐便都造成。

verses.text: He has also established them forever and ever; He has made a decree which will not pass away.
verses.textZh: 他將這些立定，直到永永遠遠；他定了命，不能廢去（或譯：越過）。

verses.text: Praise the LORD from the earth, Sea monsters and all deeps;
verses.textZh: 所有在地上的，大魚和一切深洋，

verses.text: Fire and hail, snow and clouds; Stormy wind, fulfilling His word;
verses.textZh: 火與冰雹，雪和霧氣，成就他命的狂風，

verses.text: Mountains and all hills; Fruit trees and all cedars;
verses.textZh: 大山和小山，結果的樹木和一切香柏樹，

verses.text: Beasts and all cattle; Creeping things and winged fowl;
verses.textZh: 野獸和一切牲畜，昆蟲和飛鳥，

verses.text: Kings of the earth and all peoples; Princes and all judges of the earth;
verses.textZh: 世上的君王和萬民，首領和世上一切審判官，

verses.text: Both young men and virgins; Old men and children.
verses.textZh: 少年人和處女，老年人和孩童，都當讚美耶和華！

verses.text: Let them praise the name of the LORD, For His name alone is exalted; His glory is above earth and heaven.
verses.textZh: 願這些都讚美耶和華的名！因為獨有他的名被尊崇；他的榮耀在天地之上。

verses.text: And He has lifted up a horn for His people, Praise for all His godly ones; [Even] for the sons of Israel, a people near to Him. Praise the LORD!
verses.textZh: 他將他百姓的角高舉，因此他（或譯：他使）一切聖民以色列人，就是與他相近的百姓，都讚美他！你們要讚美耶和華！
